doc_friction.issue: Nothing warns that a target's suite skips tests locally (einvoice-preflight skips 145 without slimdom/fontoxpath), so escapes can be CI-caught mutants; redteam.py now records baseline_skipped and warns.

wall-framing-takeoff and ai-bookkeeper, two top for-profit bets, have every guarded file over the 20 s probe, so a red-team run cannot target them at all without --timeout; worth a per-file suite map.

deviations.why: No blog post: this run adds tests and red-team tooling, nothing a customer reads; a post per PR is superseded by consolidated posts (2026-11-24).
deviations.did: Findings recorded in this record and the PR body.

notes: Campaigns: numbers.mjs 6/8 caught (2 equivalent: redundant undefined/null/boolean guard); peppol-readiness.mjs 4/8 caught. The 4 escapes were reachable only by plain-runner tests that skip without slimdom/fontoxpath (CI installs them). Guard: dependency-free classifyFile/summarize/toCsv/toMarkdown test; rerun shows all 4 caught (catch rate 0.714 -> 1.0). Guard added (4b): redteam.py campaign counts baseline skipped tests, warns and records baseline_skipped; on its first run it would have reported 3 skipped tests for peppol-readiness.test.mjs (the suite-level skip count is 145). Hunt: isPeppolFile's 200-char window can match a Peppol ProfileID after a non-Peppol CustomizationID, but classifyFile's sets check (from matchingAddons on BT-24) filters it out, so it is not a defect. Verification: prompts unittest test_redteam 27 OK; run_venture_tests.py einvoice-preflight ok (2829 tests, 145 skipped).

human_equivalent.basis: mutation triage, two guard tests and a tooling change

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
